name: 01_spectrum_classic_hsv_5tier
description: Classic 5-tier rainbow HSV spectrum (100%, 75%, 50%, 25%, 0% grayscale) with specular highlights and deep shadow roll-off.

name: 02_oklch_perceptual_uniform
description: Perceptually uniform color spectrum using modern Oklch color space. Eliminates harsh yellow spikes and dark blue banding in standard RGB.

name: 03_cyberpunk_neon_pulse
description: Vibrant synthwave & cyberpunk palette (Acid Magenta, Neon Violet, Cyber Cyan, Lime Green, Electric Yellow).

name: 04_cinematic_teal_and_orange
description: Industry-standard Hollywood blockbuster color grade. Rich warm amber/orange skin highlights with deep complementary teal/cyan shadows.

name: 05_anime_ghibli_pastel
description: Soft studio anime / cel-shaded palette with delicate pastel tones, gentle sky blues, blush pinks, and lush grassy greens.

name: 06_thermal_heatmap_infrared
description: High-contrast scientific and stylized thermal vision LUT (White core -> Yellow -> Red -> Magenta -> Cobalt Blue -> Dark Abyss).

name: 07_golden_hour_twilight
description: Warm sunset to twilight horizon. Radiant peach, fiery amber, rose gold, deep plum, and nightfall navy.

name: 08_fantasy_arcane_emerald
description: Mystic fantasy / gemstone palette with glowing turquoise, imperial gold, deep forest emerald, and arcane amethyst.

name: 09_grimdark_industrial_mech
description: Tactical gritty sci-fi mood. Weathered rust orange, oxidized brass, industrial steel cyan, and charcoal soot.

name: 10_vaporwave_retro_80s
description: Nostalgic retro aesthetic with candy pink, pastel lavender, neon sky cyan, and soft apricot.

name: 11_classic_2tier_render_lut
description: 2-tier classic shader map (Top block: 100% Hue spectrum with specular & shadow, Bottom block: Pure Grayscale).

name: 12_compact_3tier_diffuse_lut
description: 3-tier diffuse shading map (High Saturation, Medium Saturation, Subtle Saturation) with direct base-to-shadow falloff.
